description: Olostep turns the web into clean, structured data for AI. Search the web with natural language, scrape any URL into Markdown, HTML, JSON, or screenshots, crawl entire sites, and get AI-powered answers grounded in web sources. Reliable, cost-effective, and built to scale to billions of requests, Olostep lets you pull real-time web data directly into ChatGPT without managing browsers, proxies, or scrapers.
